If you can manage to chew it up and swallow it, you'll restore some hearts and lower your body temperature.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Icy Meats are a type of [[Frozen Food]], being the result of [[Raw Meat]] that has been frozen by a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They can also be found in [[Wooden Box]]es in the [[Hebra Mountains]]. Eating one will restore one [[Heart]] to [[Link]] and grant him one temporary level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Icy Meats return as a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by exposing [[Raw Meat]]s to either a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. When eaten, one [[Heart]] will be restored to [[Link]], and he will receive one temporary level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Steaks Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept art of Icy Meat and other varieties of Raw Meat ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Food * Icy Gourmet Meat * Icy Prime Meat * Raw Meat * Seared Steak }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Meats |items= BotW, TotK }}
